hypothesis: Hard pseudo-label CE keeps changing already-correct outputs. Fixed-teacher T^2 KL removes that confidence-increase pressure and retains all class probabilities. Compare joint scaling objective and matched preservation-only condition; preserving synthetic logits may still fail on real tasks.
objective: Replace only the native hard-label CE in the prior fixed driver by T^2 KL(softmax(original_expert_logits/T)||softmax(publication_logits/T)), T4 reused from historical data-free protocols. Scaled task loss remains hard-label CE with lambda.005/s. Same initialization,800views,200steps,batch16,seed0,AdamW,12MLP,SVD32,per-matrixA2/B4 and affine bias coupling. No original-expert gradients, no feature reconstruction or correctness veto.
differences_from_paper: Trap2 native/scaled objective is adapted; standard teacher-output matching from Hinton et al.(2015), not a novel loss, not an official data-free Trap2 reproduction. Earlier KL studies used different large fixed reflections, block reconstruction or constrained B-only fits; this controlled comparison tests the full joint update from the unchanged successful native parent. Does not reopen or change a previous release.
computation: 400 fixed publication updates total. Original expert/public base/head remain frozen. No new input synthesis, real construction images, test/partner selection, or independent hyperparameter sweep. Both references are the original expert, not the previous failed points.
evaluation: Freeze both final releases before any complete MNIST or partner evaluation. Reuse matched clean scores. Complete native,TA.5,AGA target/both,ProDistill64 per task/100steps per block for both; report utility failures as failures. No best-condition replacement, cross-task expansion or post-test tuning. Paired/per-class audit in existing evaluation code.

references.method: Native/scaled CE objective; AdamW betas(.9,.98),eps1e-6; paperfull lr1e-4; scale.05..2 excluding.95..1.05; w(s)=1/s. Weightdecay0 to avoid changing SVD restrictions by regularizer.
